title: Risk Score Bands for Prior Authorization Review-Time Extensions
content:
**Rule.** The risk cut of a member-requested deadline extension follows the risk score on the member's active care management episode: a score of 3.00 or more cuts two days; a score of 2.00 up to 2.99 cuts one day; a lower score, or no active episode, cuts nothing.

The risk score is the one on the member's Care Management episode whose status is active. The days are subtracted once from the days a member-requested deadline extension adds, before the limits of one day and of the class's most review-extension days are applied. The rule belongs to Prior Authorization review time.

| Risk score on the active episode | Days cut |
|---|---|
| 3.00 or more | 2 |
| 2.00 up to 2.99 | 1 |
| below 2.00 | 0 |
| no active episode | 0 |

## Boundary scores (hypothetical)

| Score | Days cut |
|---|---|
| 3.00 | 2 |
| 2.99 | 1 |
| 2.00 | 1 |
| 1.99 | 0 |
